handbook.promptcritical.entry.complex.ov: Find coal and read [Coal and steam: where to start](promptcritical:i0/coal_and_steam).
The ladder of industries. You are here: I0. Click an epoch to open its chapter.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.complex.re: Put a pressure gauge on a boiler
Normal, warning and alarm bands of a gauge scale (ISA-101).
Water reaches the boiler through Create pipes.
Fire-tube boiler: furnace, fire tubes, water space, steam space, safety valve, feed.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.coal.hi: Mine raw coal from a seam
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.coal.pa: lower heating value of the as-received fuel, kJ/kg
carbon, hydrogen, oxygen and sulphur, % by mass
D. I. Mendeleev's formula: what an assay is worth in heat. Seam G coal: about 23.9 MJ/kg.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.coal_an: Coal and steam: where to start
Gears change speed and torque between the engine and machines.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.coal_pr: Mine raw coal from a seam
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.first_s: Once the shaft turns, read [The boiler](promptcritical:i0/boiler) and put a pressure gauge on.
Boiler with chimney, engine at the side, stoker and gauge at the front. The real chimney is taller: 15-20 links.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.foundry: casting modulus: volume over cooling surface, cm
mould constant: about 2–3 min/cm² for sand
Chvorinov's rule: the riser must freeze last, so its modulus is at least 1.2 times the casting's.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.hoist_d: weight per metre times hanging length
safety factor and breaking load of the rope
People ride only at SF ≥ 9, goods at SF ≥ 6.5.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.longwal: Powered supports move on Create piston contraptions.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.machine: The machine shop
cutting speed, m/min
tool life, min
Taylor exponent and constant: 0.125 and about 70 m/min for high-speed steel
Taylor's tool life: a slightly faster cut wears the tool out many times sooner.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.mine_su: Mine raw coal from a seam
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.mine_ve: friction factor of the lining, N·s²/m⁴
perimeter, length and cross-section of the airway
pressure drop, Pa, and airflow, m³/s
Atkinson's law: halving the section multiplies the resistance eightfold.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.procedu: Issued with the main mine fan
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.steam_e: cut-off: share of the stroke with steam admitted
swept volume, revolutions per second, cylinders
Indicated power. Earlier cut-off saves steam but lowers power.
How Create shafts carry the engine's rotation.
handbook.promptcritical.route.i0.title: Coal and steam
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.handbook: Keep the handbook at hand: every route step opens the chapter that explains it.
The book is handed out once, on first join. If it is lost, it is crafted from a book and coal.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.coal_sea: Mine a block of a coal seam: a flat layer of coal in the rock, not a scattered ore.
Seams lie flat and stretch far. Look at cliff faces, ravines and caves at the depth the chapter names.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.raw_coal: Collect 16 raw coal. Read the assay on the tooltip: volatiles, ash and moisture decide what it is good for.
Coal from different seams differs. Keep the best-assayed coal for the boiler.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.mine_sup: Set 4 mine supports. A wide working under weak rock collapses without them.
Put a support every few blocks along the drift, right under the roof.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.safety_l: Carry a flame safety lamp underground: it gives light and its flame shows firedamp.
A taller, bluish flame means methane. Leave the working and ventilate it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.canary.t: Hang a canary cage in the mine. The bird reacts to bad air before people do.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.canary.h: Place the cage underground, in the working where people stay.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.canary_s: If the canary faints, take it to fresh air and revive it. Then find out why the air went bad.
Take a fallen bird out of the cage while it is still alive: away from the bad air it recovers.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.methanom: Make a methanometer: a lamp only warns, the instrument gives the percentage.
Above 1 % stop work in the face, above 2 % take the people out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.self_res: Carry a self-rescuer. After an explosion the air is full of carbon monoxide.
Put it on at the first sign of smoke and walk to fresh air against the smoke.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.main_fan: Build a main mine fan at the shaft mouth. It drives fresh air through the whole mine.
The fan needs rotation from Create. Fresh air must go in by one way and out by another.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.ventilat: Set 2 ventilation doors so that air does not short-circuit to the exit and reaches the faces.
Two doors in a row make an air lock: one is always closed.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.regulato: Make a ventilation regulator: set in a branch drift, its window decides how much air the branch receives.
A narrower window adds resistance, and the air goes to the branches that need it more.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.degasifi: Drill a degasification borehole: it takes methane out of the coal before it reaches the air.
Connect the borehole to a degasification pump.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.dispatch: Set up a mine dispatch cabinet to see the air and gas of the mine in one place.
Put it on the surface, near the shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.stone_du: Grind 16 stone dust. Spread on the floor, it keeps coal dust from carrying an explosion.
Spread it with a stone duster along the drifts.
Build an explosion barrier: the blast tips the shelves and the dust cloud stops the flame.
Put barriers in the drifts between the faces and the shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.coal_jig: Build a coal jig. Water pulses separate clean coal from the heavy rock.
The jig needs rotation and water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.washed_c: Get 32 washed coal: less ash, more heat in the boiler.
Middlings burn too, refuse goes to the dump.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.boiler.t: Build a fire-tube boiler: the heart of the steam plant.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.boiler.h: Fill it with water before lighting. A boiler fired dry is ruined.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.stoker.t: Fit a grate stoker so the coal feeds itself.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.stoker.h: The stoker needs a slow shaft from Create.
Raise the chimney by 2 sections. A taller stack draws better.
A cold stack draws weakly. The draught grows as the flue gas warms the stack.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.gauge.te: Mount a pressure gauge on the boiler. You cannot keep a pressure you cannot see.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.gauge.hi: The red mark is the working pressure. The safety valve lifts a little above it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.fusible_: Keep a spare fusible plug. When the water drops too low the plug melts and puts the fire out.
A melted plug is a warning, not a fault: find out why the water went down.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.engine.t: Build a steam engine next to the boiler.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.engine.h: The engine takes steam from the boiler it touches.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.first_st: Raise steam and start the engine: it turns a Create shaft.
Light the fire, wait for pressure, open the stop valve. If the crank sits on dead centre, bar it over.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.steady_p: Keep the drum pressure at 1.2 ± 0.1 MPa for 10 minutes without a break.
Fire to the load: more steam taken, more coal on the grate. Stay within 64 blocks of the boiler.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.governor: Make a governor dashpot. Without damping the flyball governor hunts and the speed swings.
Use the dashpot on the engine to fit it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.engine_s: Keep the engine running for 20 minutes without stopping.
Keep water and coal coming. Below a fifth of rated speed the engine counts as stopped.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.hoist.te: Build a mine hoist: the coal goes up the shaft, not by the stairs.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.hoist.hi: The hoist drum needs a shaft from the steam engine.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.headfram: Stack 2 or more headframe sections over the shaft.
The sheave at the top carries the rope from the drum down the shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.wire_rop: Make a wire rope for the hoist.
A rope wears with every trip. Check its safety factor in the chapter.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.cage.tex: Hang a mine cage in the shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.cage.hin: Do not overload the cage: the rope load includes its own weight down the shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.drainage: Set a mine drainage pump. Water keeps seeping into the workings.
Put the pump at the lowest point of the mine.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.cupola.t: Build a cupola: a shaft furnace that melts iron with coke and blast air.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.cupola.h: The blower takes rotation. Until there is coke, charcoal will do.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.crucible: Build a crucible furnace: slow and small, but it needs no blast.
A cupola or a crucible: either melts iron for castings.
The cupola is faster but needs steam power for the blower.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.iron_ore: Mine iron ore: magnetite or hematite.
Ore bodies are veins: where you find one block, more lie nearby.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.iron_cha: Gather 8 iron for the charge: pig iron or iron ingots.
Until there is a blast furnace, smelt iron ingots from ore.
Build a molding station to ram sand molds around a pattern.
Mold sand must be dry: rain spoils an open mold.
Pour a mold and get a casting.
Thick sections cool slowly: let the casting solidify before shaking it out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.shakeout: Build a shakeout grate to break castings out of the sand.
Put the molds on the grate.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.lathe.te: Build a lathe to turn castings to size.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.lathe.hi: Cutting speed matters: too fast and the tool wears out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.drill.te: Build a drill press for holes in the castings.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.drill.hi: It runs from the same shaft as the lathe.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.cutting_: Tool life follows Taylor's law, given in the chapter.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.longwall: Build a longwall shearer: it cuts the coal along the whole face.
The shearer runs on a Create contraption along the face.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.roof_sup: Set 4 powered roof supports along the face.
The supports advance behind the shearer, and the roof caves in behind them.
Put the boiler operating procedure on a document lectern next to the boiler.
The procedure is issued when you build the boiler.
handbook.promptcritical.route.i1.title: Steel and power
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.copper_o: Mine 8 raw chalcopyrite. Generators, motors and wires need copper: without it there is no current.
Chalcopyrite is a brass-yellow copper ore with sulphur. Look for veins in stone, deepslate and tuff.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.copper_w: Make 16 copper wire: it goes into generator and motor windings and into cables.
One copper ingot gives 3 wire at a crafting table.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.silica_b: Fire 64 silica bricks; the smallest battery takes about 120, 72 for the ovens and 48 for the flue walls. Silica brick stands the heat of the coke battery flue walls and does not sag under load.
Silica brick is fired in a furnace from vein quartz or nether quartz.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.coke_bat: Build a battery of at least three chambers, each 4 blocks long and 3 high: 36 coke oven blocks with flue walls between. Sealed from the air, coal bakes for many hours into the strong coke a blast furnace needs.
Set the ovens in a row with flue walls between them. There is no gas of your own yet, so the first heat-up burns coal or coke in the warm-up firebox on the panel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.gas_main: Lay a gas collector main over the ovens. Coking coal gives off gas, which is collected and drawn off for cleaning and firing.
Exhausters hold the pressure. Surplus gas escapes through bleeders, while suction in the main draws in air and ends in an explosion.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.first_co: Push out the first coke: the pusher ram runs right through the oven and shoves out the glowing coke cake.

Mount the ram on a Create contraption facing the end of a finished oven. Keep a contraption with storage on the coke side, or the burning coke spills onto the ground. Underdone coke sticks in the oven.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.quench_t: Build a coke quench tower. Glowing coke burns away in the open air, so it is drenched with water right away.
Drive the contraption with the hot coke into the tower and pipe water to the tower.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.byproduc: Build a by-product recovery unit. Coke oven gas yields tar, ammonium sulphate and crude benzol, and the cleaned gas goes to the burners.
Put the unit on the gas line after the collector main. Tar drops out as the gas cools; ammonium sulphate needs sulphuric acid, benzol needs wash oil.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.sinter.t: Make 16 sinter. Fine ore chokes a blast furnace and blocks the gas, while lumps sintered with flux let it breathe.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.sinter.h: The sinter strand needs a turning shaft, ore or concentrate, coke breeze, flux and ignition gas. Set the CaO/SiO₂ basicity on the panel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.hot_blas: Build a hot blast stove. Hot blast carries heat into the hearth, and the furnace burns less coke.
The stove is first fired with gas, then the blast is passed through its glowing checkerwork. Keep it within 12 blocks of the blast furnace.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.blast_bl: Build a blast blower: the furnace breathes the blast that enters the hearth through the tuyeres.
The blower needs a turning Create shaft. Keep it within 12 blocks of the blast furnace.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.blast_fu: Build a blast furnace and its control panel. In the stack coke strips oxygen from the ore, and liquid iron and slag collect in the hearth.

Lay the shell as a 5×5 ring 12–18 blocks tall: the inner 3×3 stays empty, the bottom is solid. Taphole in the first layer, tuyeres in the second, the furnace top above the centre, the panel against the shell.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.first_ir: Tap iron from the blast furnace. The taphole is drilled open, the metal runs down the runner into a ladle, and the hole is plugged again after the cast.
Put the cast house machine at the taphole and run an iron runner from the taphole to a hot metal ladle. Open the hole with the drill, then close it with the mud gun and taphole clay.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.slag.tex: Collect 8 granulated slag. Slag floats on the iron and leaves with the cast; granulated, it goes into cement instead of a dump.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.slag.hin: Put a slag granulator at the runner and pipe water into it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.air_sepa: Build an air separation unit. The converter needs pure oxygen, which is made by liquefying air and separating out the nitrogen.
The main air compressor needs a shaft and cooling water; the molecular sieve, turboexpander and cryogenic tank go next to it. The unit takes a long time to cool down before the first oxygen.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.burnt_li: Burn 8 lime. In the converter lime makes the slag basic, so it pulls phosphorus and sulphur out of the steel.
Limestone or calcite is burnt in a blast furnace block.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.converte: Build a basic oxygen converter. Blowing oxygen burns surplus carbon, silicon and phosphorus out of the iron, leaving steel.
A Create shaft tilts the converter through its port. It needs an oxygen lance above the mouth, a ladle of iron on one side for charging and an empty ladle on the other for the steel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.first_st: Blow a heat and tap the steel into a ladle. Oxygen burns the carbon out in minutes, and the heat of that reaction keeps the bath hot by itself.

Tilt the converter towards the iron ladle, add scrap and lime, lower the lance and turn on the oxygen. If it slops, raise the lance or cut the oxygen. Do not overblow: once the carbon is gone, raise the lance and tilt the converter to tap.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.steel_in: Cast 4 steel ingots. Liquid steel is teemed from the ladle into ingot molds, and the ingots are rolled later.
Kill the steel at the ladle treatment station before teeming. Place the ingot mold so the ladle pours into it from above.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.reheatin: Build a reheating furnace: cold steel cannot be rolled, so the ingot is first heated until it is soft.
The furnace burns gas, coke oven or blast furnace gas. Hot metal from it burns bare hands and cools by itself, so roll it at once.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.mill_sta: Build a rolling mill stand: the rolls squeeze the hot bar pass after pass until it is thin.
Roller tables on a Create shaft carry the bar to the stand; reverse them by reversing the shaft. Close the roll gap on the panel pass by pass.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.steel_pl: Roll 8 steel plates. Plate goes into boilers, tanks and beams.
Roll it hot: the stand will not take a cold bar. Too heavy a reduction in one pass shears the safety pin.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.seamless: Pierce the first seamless pipe. A solid billet is rolled over a mandrel into a shell, and a pipe with no seam holds high pressure.
Heat the billet to 1200–1250 °C and feed it straight into the piercing mill: a cooled billet will not pierce.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.hydrotes: Build a hydrostatic test bench. Every pipe is proven with water at more than its working pressure before it goes into service.
Test with water, not air: water barely compresses, so a pipe that fails just leaks instead of exploding.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.generato: Put a generator on a Create shaft: the turning of the steam engine becomes three-phase power at 6 kV.
The generator is built of steel plate and beam from your own mill. It needs a steady speed. Match it with the shaft gearing and the speed trimmer on the panel.
Build a generator exciter: the current in the rotor winding sets the generator's voltage and reactive power.
Without excitation the generator turns but makes no voltage. Trim the voltage with the excitation control on the panel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.switchge: Build a 6 kV switchgear cell. Its breaker connects a generator or a feeder to the busbars and clears a short circuit.
Every generator and every outgoing feeder has its own cell. Without control power the breaker will not close.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.synchros: Build a synchroscope: its pointer shows the frequency difference and phase angle between the generator and the grid.
A pointer turning towards FAST means the generator runs ahead of the grid, towards SLOW that it lags. The slower it turns, the closer the frequencies.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.first_sy: Close a generator onto a live grid with a torque shock of no more than 10 %. Closing out of phase hammers the shaft and can shear the coupling.
Match the voltage with excitation and the speed with the trimmer, so the pointer creeps slowly towards FAST. Press CLOSE just before twelve o'clock: the breaker takes a moment to close.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.transfor: Build a 6/0.4 kV transformer. Power travels cheaply at 6 kV, but motors and settlements take 0.4 kV.
Feed the high side from a switchgear cell and run the low side to 0.4 kV loads. An overloaded transformer runs hot and ages faster.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.power_li: Set 4 wooden poles and string a conductor: this is how power travels far from the station.
Fit pin insulator heads to the poles and run bare conductor from insulator to insulator. A loaded conductor heats up and sags, most of all on a long span.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.consumer: Connect 2 settlement loads. Load brakes the generators: as demand rises the frequency falls until the engines get more steam.
A settlement takes 0.4 kV through a transformer.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.electric: Build an electric motor: now a machine is driven by power from the grid, not by a steam engine standing next to it.
On starting a motor draws several times its rated current and the grid voltage dips. Do not start big motors all at once.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.relay_ca: Build a relay protection cabinet. Its relay modules detect short circuits and overloads and trip the breaker.
Plug relay modules into the cabinet and set them on its panel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.ufls.tex: Let under-frequency load shedding drop part of the load when power runs short. Better to black out a settlement than let the frequency sink and lose the whole station.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.ufls.hin: Put a UFLS relay module into a consumer (the settlement) or an electric motor. Load the grid beyond the generators' output or trip one of them: the frequency falls and the UFLS stage operates. Auto-reclose returns the load once the frequency is back at 49.7 Hz.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.relays.t: Place 5 control relays. An energised coil throws its contacts, and contacts make logic: AND, OR, seal-in, interlocks.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.relays.h: The relay terminals are labelled: the coil is A1 and A2, the contact terminals are next to them.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.relay_po: Build a 24 V DC power supply: relay circuits run on low DC voltage.
The supply is fed from a 0.4 kV bus. Hang too many coils on it and the voltage sags until relays start dropping out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.relay_lo: Build a circuit of 5 or more relays that switches on a machine. Factories were automated this way long before computers.
Run the wires with the wiring tool from terminal to terminal. Drive the machine through a relay–redstone interface, a motor starter or a breaker.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.manual_s: Build a manual/auto station. It shows the process value and setpoint and hands control from the operator to the controller and back.
In MAN you set the output yourself, in AUTO the controller does. Switch to AUTO once the value sits at the setpoint, to avoid a bump.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.analog_l: Build a PI controller from a summing amplifier and an integrator and hold the value at the setpoint (±2 % of span) for a whole game day.
A signal converter gives the measurement, the summing amplifier forms the error, the integrator removes the steady offset. The station must be in AUTO. If the loop oscillates, lower the gain.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.water_tr: Build a sodium ion exchange column. Hard water leaves scale in the boiler; the metal under it overheats and the tubes burst.
The train is a lime clarifier, a sand filter, then the ion exchanger. Regenerate an exhausted column with salt: after breakthrough it passes raw water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.water_tu: Build a water-tube boiler with its BMS panel. Water runs through the wall tubes around the flame, so it makes more steam at higher pressure than a fire-tube boiler.

Build the furnace from water walls with burners, then add the drum, superheater, economizer, air preheater, forced draft fan and induced draft fan. Light it only through the BMS: purge, igniter, then main fuel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.deaerato: Build a deaerator. Oxygen dissolved in the feedwater eats the boiler wall tubes, and steam drives it out.
Keep the deaerator within 12 blocks of the water-tube boiler. It takes heating steam from the drum once the drum is above 0.3 MPa.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.maintena: Build a maintenance panel. It shows machine faults, the commissioning checklist and the equipment passport.
A new machine may be installed with defects. Work through the checklist — tests, checks, a trial run — before putting it under load.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.recorded: Take a recorded chart off a recording gauge: the trace shows how the machine behaved while you were away.
Put a recording gauge on a boiler, engine, fan or pump and load chart paper. Let the drum record, then take the chart off with an empty hand; use the chart to unroll it.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.coke_pl: The coke plant: battery and by-products
A pusher ram on a Create contraption pushes the cake out of a ready oven into the quench car.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.blast_f: Place a blast furnace control panel
Blast furnace in section: furnace top, 3×3 shaft inside the shell, tuyeres in the second layer, taphole in the first, hearth floor.
The drill opens the taphole, iron runs down the runner into the ladle, the mud gun plugs the taphole with clay.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.generat: Synchroscope: the pointer turns at slip frequency. Close ahead of twelve o'clock.
A synchroscope on a switchgear cell: matching frequency and voltage, then closing the breaker.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.grid_an: The grid, protection and load shedding
A UFLS relay in a settlement: on a frequency dip the load is dropped, and reclosing brings it back.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.relay_l: A seal-in starter: STOP, START, contactor coil KM1 and its auxiliary contact 13-14.
A relay: coil A1-A2, contacts 11-12-14 and 21-22-24, wired with the wiring tool.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.water_a: The water-tube boiler and water treatment
Work permits, hot work and turnaround
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.energy_: Surplus energy: pumped storage and the electrode boiler
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.tidal.t: Tidal power: the Moon, the bay and the dam
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.lamp_ro: The lamp room: cap lamps and charging
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.wind.ti: Wind power: rotor and induction generator
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.graphit: Synchronize a generator onto the grid
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.acheson_: Build an Acheson furnace. Baked electrodes become graphite only at 2500–3000 °C, and only electricity gets there.
It is a 500 kW load: run a 6 kV cable to any face from a synchronized generator.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.reactor_: Make 64 blocks of reactor graphite. A pile is mostly graphite; the uranium is the small part.
Two graphite electrodes per block. The furnace refuses electrodes cracked by a hasty bake.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.pitchble: Mine 16 raw pitchblende from a hydrothermal vein.
The veins lie between Y −48 and 32 with galena, pyrite and quartz, more often under mountains.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.uranium_: Make 64 slug cassettes of natural uranium metal: enough for eight full fuel blocks.
Crush, mill, leach to yellowcake, roast to dioxide, then reduce with magnesium in a superheated mixer.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.pile_des: Place a pile control desk against your graphite stack.
The desk finds the stack, rods and counters by itself. Its panel tells you how many cubic metres it sees.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.source_c: See at least 10 counts per second on a BF₃ counter of a loaded pile.
Put the Ra-Be source in the stack and a counter against an outer face. Every cassette you add raises the count: that is subcritical multiplication.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.first_cr: Bring the pile critical: the chain reaction holds without the source for five seconds.
Wind the zip rods, then withdraw the control rods in steps. Plot 1/count against rod position and never step past where the line meets zero.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i1.pile_ste: Hold the pile between 10 and 200 W for five minutes, as CP-1 ran.
A critical pile drifts. Nudge the control rods so the period stays long, and read the ion chamber, not the counter: the counter saturates.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i0.machine: Machine tools
specific cutting force, N/mm²
Kienzle constants of the material: about 1450 N/mm² and 0.27 for steel 45, 1020 and 0.25 for grey iron
chip thickness, mm (for a milling cutter, the mean over the arc of contact)
metal removal rate, mm³/s
Kienzle: the thinner the chip, the harder each square millimetre cuts.
mean and peak-to-valley roughness
feed per stroke or per revolution, mm
tool nose radius, mm
Halve the feed and the surface gets four times smoother — and the cut takes twice as long.
specific grinding energy, J/mm³
energy of chip formation, about 13.8 J/mm³ for steel
share of worn flats on the wheel face: 0.2 % after dressing, 2 % when loaded
down-feed per pass, mm
burn limit: falls as the down-feed grows
Malkin: a deep pass or a loaded wheel puts more heat into the work than it can take, and the surface burns.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.shaper.t: Build a shaping machine to plane slideways and plates.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.shaper.h: Cast a machine bed first: switch the pattern until it shows the bed.
Build a knee milling machine: it needs slideways from the shaper.
It cuts gear teeth into a gear blank that has been turned on the lathe.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i0.spur_gea: A coarse feed per tooth leaves the flanks too rough, and the gear goes to scrap.
Build a surface grinder and grind a planed plate flat.
Keep the shaft at 64 rpm: a wheel spun past 1.5 × its working speed bursts.
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i2.plc.hin: Place a relay, then stop rewiring
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i1.nonferr: Non-ferrous metals: alumina, aluminium, copper, nickel, tin
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i4.spent_f: Spent fuel and the cooling pool
handbook.promptcritical.entry.i4.radwast: Radioactive waste: from the drain tank to the repository
handbook.promptcritical.entry.t3.heavy_w: Heavy water: making it and keeping it pure
handbook.promptcritical.route.i2.title: Oil and Gas
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.seismic_: Oil is found by listening to the ground: a charge sends a wave down, the layers send it back.
Make four charges; the survey chapter shows how far apart to fire them.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.geophone: Geophones in a line pick up the echo from each layer.
Put four geophones in a straight line, a few blocks apart.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.seismic_: The station records the geophones and turns the echoes into a section of the ground.
Place it at the end of the geophone line.
A section shows where the layers bend up into a trap: that is where to drill.
Fire the charges with the station recording, then take the section from it.
Tar on the surface means oil once migrated up here.
Look in low ground and along river banks; mine one block of it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.gas_seep: Gas bubbling out of the ground marks a field below.
Seeps hiss and bubble in water; break one to record it.
The derrick carries the drill string over the hole.
Stack three derrick segments over the spot the section picked.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rotary_t: The rotary table turns the string; Create shaft power drives it.
Place it at the foot of the derrick and bring a shaft to it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.drawwork: The drawworks lifts and lowers the string and sets the weight on the bit.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.mud_pump: Mud carries the cuttings up and holds the well's pressure back.
Drive the pump from a shaft and pipe it to the rotary table.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.mud_tank: Pit volume is your kick alarm: the level rises when the well flows.
Place three tanks in a row near the pump.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rig.text: The driller's console sees the whole rig and starts the hole.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rig.hint: Place the console within reach of the rotary table; it lists what is missing.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.bop.text: A preventer closes the well when gas comes up: without it a kick becomes a blowout.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.bop.hint: Mount it on the wellhead under the rotary table.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.bop_accu: The accumulator keeps pressure to shut the preventer even with the power gone.
Place it next to the preventer.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.choke.te: With the well shut, the choke bleeds the gas out at a pressure you control.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.choke.hi: Pipe it to the preventer's side outlet.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.logging_: Logging lowers sondes down the hole and reads the rocks along it.
Place it next to the rig.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.gamma_so: Shale glows in gamma, sand does not: the log finds the reservoir.
Make the sonde and load it into the logging unit.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.core.tex: A core is a piece of the reservoir in your hands: porosity and oil saturation.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.core.hin: Run the core barrel into the hole at the reservoir depth.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.core_sta: The station measures the core and says how much oil the field holds.
Place it and put the core in.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.wellhead: The wellhead holds the casing strings at the surface once drilling is over.
Set it on the finished well.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.christma: The tree's valves open and close the flowing well.
Place it on top of the wellhead.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.first_oi: The separator splits the well stream into oil, gas and water.
Pipe the tree to a three-phase separator and open the well.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.pumpjack: When the reservoir pressure falls, the pumpjack lifts the oil.
Put it beside the wellhead and drive it from a shaft.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rod_pump: The pump at the bottom of the rods does the actual lifting.
Make one and run it into the well.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.flare.te: Gas you cannot use or store goes to the flare, not to the air.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.flare.hi: Build a stack at least six blocks high away from the plant.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.flare_ti: The tip keeps a pilot burning so released gas always ignites.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.knockout: Liquid carried into a flare comes down as burning rain; the drum catches it first.
Put it in the flare line before the stack.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.tube_fur: Crude is heated to about 360 °C before it enters the column.
Fire it on associated gas from the separator.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.desalter: Salt in crude corrodes the column; the desalter washes it out with water and a field.
Place it within six blocks of the tube furnace; it feeds the furnace itself.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.crude_co: The column splits crude by boiling point: gas, gasoline, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil.
Place the column base next to the furnace.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.column_t: The column counts its tray sections only up to a top.
Stack at least three tray sections on the base and finish with the top.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.vacuum_c: Fuel oil boils without cracking only under vacuum: gas oil comes off, tar stays.
Put steam ejectors on both sides of it; without them it runs at atmosphere.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.coker.te: The coker turns tar into light products and petroleum coke.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.fcc_cata: Zeolite cracks heavy gas oil into gasoline.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.fcc.text: The FCC burns coke off the catalyst in the regenerator and cracks gas oil in the riser.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.fcc.hint: It needs air: a centrifugal compressor on a shaft next to it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.hydrotre: Cobalt-molybdenum takes sulfur out of diesel with hydrogen.
Sulfur leaves the diesel as hydrogen sulfide.
Load the catalyst, feed diesel from the side and hydrogen from above.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.claus.te: Hydrogen sulfide burns to sulfur instead of going to the flare.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.claus.hi: Place it right next to the hydrotreater: it takes the H2S directly.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.sulfur.t: Sulfur from oil is the raw material for sulfuric acid.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.sulfur.h: Collect sixteen from the Claus unit.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.reformer: Reforming raises the octane of straight-run gasoline and gives hydrogen.
Feed naphtha and fuel gas; the hydrogen goes back to the hydrotreater.
Sold gasoline is a blend of reformate and cracked gasoline to an octane spec.
Pipe both streams to the blender.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.lts.text: Cold separation drops water and heavy ends out of the gas so it can go down a pipe.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.gas_comp: The compressor raises the gas to line pressure.
Drive it from a shaft after the gas plant.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.amine.te: Amine pulls hydrogen sulfide and CO2 out of sour gas.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.amine.hi: Put it on the gas line; its acid gas can go to the Claus unit.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.lpg.text: Propane and butane are kept liquid under pressure in bullets.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.lpg.hint: Place a bullet and fill it from the gas plant.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.helium.t: Some fields carry a little helium; cold separation recovers it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.helium.h: Feed it gas from a helium-bearing field.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.cryo_tan: Liquid helium and nitrogen boil away unless kept in an insulated tank.
Place it next to the helium unit.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.plc.text: A PLC does what a cabinet of relays did, and you can reprogram it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.plc.hint: Place it and wire its inputs and outputs.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.sis.text: The safety logic is separate from control: it only trips, it never regulates.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.sis.hint: Place a logic solver and give it its own sensors.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.gas_dete: Fixed detectors see a leak before a person does.
Mount one where gas would collect.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.portable: Hydrogen sulfide kills without a smell at high doses; carry a detector on the plant.
Make one and keep it in the hotbar.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rtu.text: A remote station brings far wells and pumps onto the control room screen.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.rtu.hint: Place it at the remote site.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.historia: The historian keeps every tag's trend, so you can see what happened before a trip.
Place it in the control room.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.mes.text: The MES server plans load across the plant from the historian's data.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.mes.hint: Place it next to the historian.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.control_: One room where the operators see and run the whole unit.
Place the core inside a closed room; its chapter lists what makes it habitable.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.pipe_wel: Welded pipe from plate is cheaper than seamless for long lines.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.welded_p: A pipeline needs a lot of pipe.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.pig_laun: A pig scrapes the line clean and a smart pig looks for corrosion inside it.
Put a launcher at one end of the line and a receiver at the other.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.smart_pi: The smart pig maps wall thinning along the whole line.
Make one and run it through the line.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.tank_gau: Products wait in tanks for the market; a gauge tells you how much you have.
Mount a gauge on a product tank.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.market.t: Prices move with supply: sell when the market wants your product.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i2.market.h: Place the terminal; it shows prices and takes orders.
handbook.promptcritical.route.i3.title: Chemistry
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.pyrolysi: Ethane or propane cracked with steam at 850 °C gives ethylene.
Feed propane, feedwater and fuel gas.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.cracked_: Cracked gas is cooled and split into ethylene, propylene and the rest.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.ldpe.tex: Ethylene polymerizes at very high pressure into low-density polyethylene.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.polyethy: Pellets for cable insulation and film.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.steam_re: Methane and steam over nickel give synthesis gas: hydrogen and carbon monoxide.
Fire it on gas and feed it gas and steam.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.methanol: Copper-zinc catalyst makes methanol from syngas.
Syngas at pressure over the catalyst gives crude methanol.
Columns take water and by-products out of crude methanol.
Hydrogen from the reformer and nitrogen from the air make ammonia at high pressure.
Feed hydrogen and nitrogen three to one.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.nitric_a: Ammonia burnt on platinum and absorbed in water gives nitric acid.
Feed it ammonia, air and water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.chlor_al: Brine and a lot of current give chlorine, caustic soda and hydrogen.
Power the cells from the grid; they draw a heavy DC load.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.chlorine: Chlorine is dried and liquefied to be stored and shipped.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.pvc_reac: Ethylene and chlorine give vinyl chloride; it polymerizes into PVC.
Feed it from the gas separation and the chlorine line.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.pvc.text: PVC goes into pipe and cable sheathing.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.gas_turb: A gas turbine burns gas directly and turns a generator.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.hrsg.tex: The turbine exhaust is still 500 °C hot; the boiler makes steam from it.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.hrsg.hin: Put it right behind the turbine exhaust.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.combined: Gas and steam turbine together get half the fuel's heat into power.
Feed the boiler's steam to a steam turbine.
Quartz reduced with carbon in an arc furnace gives silicon, 98 % pure.
Make four in the arc furnace.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.trichlor: Silicon with hydrogen chloride becomes a liquid that can be distilled clean.
Pure trichlorosilane deposits polysilicon on hot rods.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.polysili: Nine nines pure: ready to grow a crystal.
Take a rod out of the reactor.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.ingot.te: A crystal is pulled from the melt, one orientation through the whole ingot.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.wafer_sa: The ingot is sliced and polished into wafers.
Place the saw and give it the ingot.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.wafer.te: Every chip starts as a polished wafer.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.transist: A transistor does what a vacuum tube did, smaller and without a filament.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.chip.tex: Many transistors on one die: the logic of a whole relay cabinet in a chip.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.memory.t: Memory keeps programs and data for controllers and computers.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i3.board.te: Chips on a board make a computer.
handbook.promptcritical.route.i4.title: Nuclear Fuel
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.dosimete: You cannot feel radiation; the dosimeter is how you know your dose.
Make one and keep it with you.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.contamin: Dose rate and contamination are different things: this one checks surfaces and hands.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.decon_sh: Contamination leaves the controlled area on skin and clothes unless washed off at the exit.
Put it at the exit of the controlled area.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.decon_sp: Floors and equipment are cleaned with solutions, not water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.crushed_: Ore has a fraction of a percent of uranium; it is crushed before leaching.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.leach.te: Sulfuric acid dissolves the uranium out of the ore.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.leach.hi: Feed it ground ore and acid.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.ion_exch: Resin picks uranium out of the dilute solution.
Put it after the leach tanks.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.precipit: Ammonia drops the uranium out as a yellow paste.
Feed it the eluate and ammonia.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.yellowca: Uranium concentrate: the end of the mine and the start of the fuel cycle.
Take it from the precipitation tank.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.calciner: Calcining turns the paste into uranium oxide.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.hf.title: Hydrogen fluoride
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.hf.text: Fluorspar and sulfuric acid give HF for the conversion to UF6.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.hydroflu: HF turns the oxide into green salt, uranium tetrafluoride.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.fluorina: Fluorine gas makes UF6, the only uranium compound that is a gas at modest heat.
Feed it green salt and fluorine.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.uf6.text: Natural UF6 in a 48Y cylinder is the feed of the enrichment plant.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.uf6.hint: Fill a cylinder from the fluorination reactor.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.centrifu: A centrifuge spins UF6 so the heavier U-238 moves out a little more than U-235.
Place eight centrifuge sections in a hall.
One machine barely separates; thousands in a cascade reach reactor grade.
Place the cascade console in the centrifuge hall.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.enriched: A 30B cylinder holds product at a few percent U-235.
Run the cascade with feed, product and tails cylinders loaded.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.pellet_p: UO2 powder is pressed and sintered into ceramic pellets.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.zircon.t: Zirconium hardly absorbs neutrons: it is the cladding of fuel rods.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.zirconiu: Hafnium sits with zirconium in the ore and absorbs neutrons; it has to come out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.fuel_rod: Pellets stacked in a zirconium tube and sealed with helium.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.assembly: Rods go into a grid frame to make an assembly.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.fuel_ass: The assembly is what goes into a power reactor's core.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.fuel_rac: Spent fuel stays hot for years; it cools under water in racks.
Place a rack at the bottom of a deep pool of water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.purex.te: Nitric acid and solvent extraction split spent fuel into uranium, plutonium and waste.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.purex.hi: Place the hot cell; it handles everything behind shielding.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.denitrat: Recovered uranyl nitrate is turned back into oxide.
Feed it from the PUREX cell.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.waste_dr: Every contaminated rag and filter is waste that has to be packed.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.compacto: Pressing drums cuts the volume of solid waste several times.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.bitumeni: Liquid waste is dried into bitumen so it cannot leak.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.vitrific: High-level waste is melted into glass for thousands of years of storage.
Feed it raffinate from the PUREX cell.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.americiu: A by-product of reprocessing, the neutron source of logging sondes.
Separate it at the PUREX cell.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.rtg.text: Decay heat of an isotope and thermocouples give power for decades with no fuel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.i4.rtg.hint: Place it with a heat source loaded.
handbook.promptcritical.route.t.title: Reactors
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.fuel_chan: A power reactor is the graphite pile with water running through its fuel channels.
Place four channel blocks in the graphite stack.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.rod_drive: A rod drive moves the absorber in and out of the core.
Put it over a rod channel.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.power_rea: The reactor's heat makes steam for a turbine: nuclear power on the grid.
Place the reactor controller at the stack; its chapter lists what it needs.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.diesel.te: A shut-down core still needs cooling; the diesel powers the pumps when the grid is gone.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.diesel.hi: Place it and connect it to the station's emergency bus.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.pwr.title: Pressurized water reactor
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.pwr.text: Water under 16 MPa is both coolant and moderator: the core of most power plants today.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.pwr.hint: Place the reactor; load assemblies before the first start.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.pressuriz: A steam bubble on top of the loop holds the pressure steady.
Connect it to a hot leg.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.primary_p: The main pumps drive the water through the core.
Drive it from a shaft on the cold leg.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.steam_gen: Primary water heats secondary water through tubes; only the secondary goes to the turbine.
Place it in the loop between hot and cold leg.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.cleanup.t: Corrosion products in the coolant become activated; the cleanup takes them out.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.cleanup.h: Connect it to the primary loop.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.eccs.text: If the loop breaks, these pumps flood the core with borated water.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.eccs.hint: Place it on the emergency bus.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.containme: The last barrier: a sealed shell that holds even a broken loop.
Build the shell around the reactor hall.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.hatch.tex: People get in through an airlock that never opens both doors at once.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.hatch.hin: Set it into the containment wall.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.recombine: Hot zirconium and steam make hydrogen; recombiners burn it quietly before it explodes.
Mount them high inside the containment.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.bwr.title: Boiling water reactor
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.bwr.text: Water boils right in the core and goes to the turbine: one loop, no steam generators.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.heavy_wat: Deuterium moves between water and hydrogen sulfide with temperature: the GS process.
Vacuum distillation takes the enriched water to reactor grade.
Put it after the exchange towers.
A bucket of D2O: a moderator so good that natural uranium is enough.
Fill a bucket at the final column.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.candu.tex: Heavy water moderator, natural uranium fuel, refuelled on power.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.sfr.title: Fast reactor
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.sfr.text: Fast neutrons and sodium coolant: the reactor breeds more fuel than it burns.
handbook.promptcritical.task.t.sfr.hint: Place the reactor; it runs on plutonium from reprocessing.
